title: We Are a Circle (Within a Circle)
about: It is printed in Rainbow AU songs, vol. A, song #12, PDF p.7 (hand-notated with chords; German and French verses). A variant appears in the same book as song #8, “We are a circle, within a circle”. An independent version for comparison lives in Fire Circle Chants — We Are a Circle (Rick Hamouris).
melody_note: Encoded by eye from the songbook’s hand-drawn notation (book A #12, PDF p.7). Draft reading — verify against the book page. Note: the book’s #12 variant omits the “within a circle” line sung in variant #8 (PDF p.6, Am).
verdict: Verdict: pending. Encoded from the book’s hand-notated staff; pitch-level confidence moderate. An independent check exists: firecirclechants.com we-are-a-circle.pdf (downloaded to notation-sources/).
